answer.reason: The verses naming Epaphroditus tell of his illness and of the gifts he brought Paul from the Philippians.

clauses.english: brought Paul the gifts the Philippians had sent him
clauses.quote: having received of Epaphroditus the things which were sent from you

clauses.english: was sick nearly to death, but God had mercy on him
clauses.quote: he was sick nigh unto death: but God had mercy on him

doubts: COL 1:7, COL 4:12 and PHM 1:23 name Epaphras, a different person, so I left them out.
PHP 4:23 is a subscription note ('written ... by Epaphroditus') rather than part of the letter's text, so I did not use it.
